children: Brown & Brown reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.725 billion, up 7.4% year over year, with organic revenue growth of 1.2%. Net income attributable to the company was $240 million, while diluted earnings per share were $0.67 and adjusted diluted earnings per share were $1.07. Adjusted EBITDAC was $597 million, with an adjusted margin of 34.6%.
Total revenue was $1.725 billion, compared with $1.606 billion in the third quarter of 2025.
Income before income taxes increased 2.9% to $320 million; its margin was 18.6%, compared with 19.4% a year earlier.
Adjusted EBITDAC increased 1.7% to $597 million. Adjusted EBITDAC margin was 34.6%, down from 36.6%.
Net income attributable to the company was $240 million, up 5.7% from $227 million.
Diluted net income per share was $0.67, down 1.5%; adjusted diluted net income per share rose 1.9% to $1.07.
Organic revenue grew 1.2%; organic revenue with contingents grew 1.5%.
Chief Executive Officer J. Powell Brown said the team won more customers despite a challenging rate environment.
The company said its capabilities were enhanced by approximately 5,000 teammates who joined through the Accession acquisition just over a year earlier.
Brown & Brown described its global presence as spanning more than 700 locations, with approximately 23,000 professionals.

title: Brown & Brown Reports 7.4% Revenue Growth and $1.07 Adjusted EPS
